provenance: Results copied byte-for-byte from the isolated diagnostic runs performed earlier in this task. Those runs used the then-current working tree with uncommitted changes and did not record an immutable source digest. The source review commit identifies the later code review only; it is not retroactive version binding for the measurements.
classification: Synthetic diagnostic evidence; not release acceptance or a production capacity claim
reproductionNotes: Scripts retain the original fixture construction and timed operations. Their output location was changed to evaluation-output so rerunning them does not modify retained evidence. A reproduction executes the current compiled tree and must receive its own version and environment record. The reproduction scale script also corrects the synthetic cwd literal to C:/scale-probe; the original JavaScript backslash was an ineffective escape. The corpus uses user-confirmed repository-scoped records and does not depend on worktree matching. Historical result files remain unchanged.
